snippet.title: Big Job Games Alchemist
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2456870/BIG_JOB/
Wishlist on Steam
BIG JOB is a 1980's dystopian British bank job game, third person, cover shooter with destructible cover and elements of stealth, featuring subcultures of that era, the punks, the skinheads and corrupt coppers, the knob sticks.
